complaint_text: On the night of 3 Feb my phone suddenly lost network. Next morning I saw ₹40,000 had gone from my account by UPI to someone I do not know. I never shared any OTP or PIN with anyone. The telecom store says my SIM was replaced on 3 Feb but I did not go there. I have also filed a complaint on the cybercrime portal, ref NCRP-27-118842.
story: SIM swap by a telecom store, new device, reported next day

complaint_text: A man called saying he was from the bank KYC team and my account would be blocked. He asked me to read out the OTP I received, and I did. ₹30,000 was transferred out. I called 1930 at once (ref 1930-27-552190) and then the bank. I was told ₹10,000 has been frozen and returned.
story: Customer read out OTP to a fake KYC caller; partial recovery

complaint_text: I noticed two online purchases of ₹18,000 and ₹12,000 on my card from 1 Feb which I did not make. I was travelling and only checked my email on 8 Feb. I have never shared my card details.
story: Card data leaked at a payment aggregator; reported on day 7

complaint_text: I joined a stock tips group and they asked me to install an app so they could guide me. While the app was on they moved ₹50,000 and ₹30,000 from my account. I called the bank at 9:10 pm and 1930, but another ₹10,000 went at 9:53 pm even after I reported it.
story: Remote-access app scam, warning ignored, ₹80k before reporting plus ₹10k after

complaint_text: I gave a written request on 20 Jan to change my mobile number. I found in my statement that ₹15,000 was sent by NEFT on 1 Feb. I never got any OTP or SMS because the bank was still using my old number.
story: Bank failed to update mobile number; OTP went to reassigned old number; reported day 9

complaint_text: ₹20,000 and ₹15,000 went out by UPI on the evening of 18 Feb. I did not do these and did not share any OTP. I reported to 1930 and the bank the next morning.
story: New device bound; auth log missing for the second transaction

complaint_text: I got an SMS saying my electricity would be cut. I opened the link and paid, and entered the OTP. Later ₹25,000 was charged instead. I am reporting this to the bank. I have not filed any police or cyber complaint yet.
story: Phishing link, OTP entered; reported to bank but not to 1930 yet

complaint_text: There is a ₹12,000 payment to TechKart on 12 Feb which I do not recognise. Please reverse it.
story: Registered device, biometric, liveness passed, known merchant
